title: Sqlite3.enable_shared_cache has been removed
summary: Python 3.12 removed sqlite3.enable_shared_cache, so using it raises an error.
replacement: opening the database in URI mode with the cache=shared query parameter

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of sqlite3.enable_shared_cache with opening the database in URI mode with the cache=shared query parameter.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
